reuse.why: Edits the two existing holiday sites in shared/schedules.ts instead of adding new ones, but does not introduce one shared 'is this day a holiday' predicate for them to use.

duplication.why: The MM-DD meaning is implemented twice in different forms: a 100-year expansion into exdates in getHolidayExdates and a `dayFromDate(day).slice(5)` match in getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

placement.why: Both changes sit in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing holiday handling.

scope.why: Only the holiday logic, one test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Holiday-entry parsing now lives in two diverging encodings, and the exdate path relies on an arbitrary +100-year horizon and per-year Date construction that a maintainer must keep consistent with the slice-based matcher.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Both pre-existing holiday paths are updated; no caller goes around them.

disguised_duplication.where: shared/schedules.ts: the MM-DD rule appears as a year loop building exdates in getHolidayExdates and as a slice(5) comparison in isOff inside getDateWithSkippedWeekend.
